notes.title: Patch 1.17.18
notes.content:
I want to preface today’s patch by thanking everyone for playing the game and enjoying the content updates and new animal families we worked so hard to make. This is the last patch to add a new animal family: Reptiles! 


Going forward, we won’t have the bandwidth to add new content anymore. The game is still going to remain up and running on all platforms, but the sales aren’t steady enough to warrant content production. We’ll keep the game servers up and running for as long as our studio stays alive so you can continue to enjoy everything we made so far.



Aside: If you are interested in physical Trading Card Games, we have been working on a side project called Echoes of Astra that combines world class anime art and tactical decision making in a card game. 

Follow Echoes of Astra Kickstarter here.

 Now back to Claws & Chaos, here’s what we added for patch 1.17: 
Content Updates and Changes
NEW Family: Reptiles

Reptiles focus around the concept of Debuffing enemies and benefitting from Lifesteal/Heals.

Family Bonus: Reptiles get +\[10|15|20]% Lifesteal when enemy target has 3+ debuffs

Gecko Painter (Tier 1) - Inflicts Weak. (Weak reduces ATK by 10% / stack)

Chameleon Tattooist (Tier 2) - When healed, Gain ATK SPD.

Double Agent Boa (Tier 2) - Inflict Poison and Mark stacks. (Mark reduces DMG resist by 10% / stack)

Turtle Ninja (Tier 2) -  Dash forward. Attacks inflict Weak and Mark

Alligator Father (Tier 3) - Pull the closest enemy to this unit and Stun the target

Croc Conservationist (Tier 3) - When healed, Gain Shield and ATK

Frilled Neck Rockstar (Tier 3) - Inflict stacks of Weak in an area

Tortoise Retiree (Tier 4) - On Hurt: Inflicts Slow on the attacker

Active Arena Rotation: Cat, Dog, Rabbit, Raccoon, Bird, Monkey, Mustelid, Reptile

Bug Fixes and QoL
(Mobile) Language selector added on splash page

(Mobile) Increase Incentivized Ad allowance to 6 per 4 hrs

(Mobile) Fixed bug to actually make the refresh every 4 hours

(Mobile) Added Settings toggle to turn off Ad notifications

Fixed some Lore issues with Red Panda Zombie and Ringtail Miner

Fixed issue with negative stat values causing crashing (Penguin Student’s Slow wasn’t capped)

Fixed issue with Highland Warrior Dark Ages skin not dealing damage on his first attack. (not in build yet)

notes.title: Mobile Launch Prep Patch - Feb 26th
notes.content:
Crossplay is here! Mobile Claws & Chaos launches on Feb. 27th so you can play on the go!  Connect your mobile email account now in the game’s Settings > Profile page so you can jump right in when mobile comes out. 

Features

Mobile version launched on Android and iOS App stores!
PC Login selector for email (mobile) accounts



Quality of Life

 Thief’s Haul drop rate display added on the main menu next to the button.
 Campaign 2 Challenge mode balanced to make the later rounds easier
 Popup for the Right-size package to all PC players
 Localization updates in all languages


Bug Fixes

 Fixed bug in which Lore progress on a unit was not saving after battles. This should resolve the issue where you combine a unit to 3, but seemingly can’t upgrade their lore.
 UI fixes for 4:3 tablet view resolution (Inventory screen, News screen, Rapture buff selection)

notes.title: Patch Notes - Claws & Chaos v1.08.18
notes.content:
It’s been a bit more than a week of gameplay since we added the Ranked System to Rapture Mode, and in this patch we’ve continued to refine the system.  This patch will be live in about 30 minutes, at 11am ET. 

We also have added new achievements (Bucket List Missions) for you pro autobattlers.  And of course, some UI tweaks and combat balances.  

Here’s everything new and changed in Claws & Chaos v1.08.18:

System Changes
  Ranked System adjustments are being made after the first week of gameplay to increase visibility and feel.   Weekly Decay is being reduced from -50 > -25. Rewards remain the same.  Information about rewards and decay will now show up as a popup every time a player begins a rapture run.  Weekly Leaderboard rewards will show a shiny new animation when rewards are available to collect.  Added Rank display row on Player Profile cards.   New Bucket List Missions (Achievements) added for all the ranked tiers from Silver to Masters.   Removed the Reach Rapture wave 30 mission, since that’s no longer possible.  
UI / UX
  Adjusted timing on the “Shining Paw” animation in Thief’s Haul animation.  Changed shine particle on Thief’s Haul button to a red dot when it’s ready.  Added a Discord button reminder of the Free Skin (Wumpus!). 
Combat Balances
Small adjustments on the higher win rate units meant to tamper down the impact of econ a bit more. Unethical Developer Gibbon is also being indirectly nerfed with the Poison adjustments.

Poison Status Effect

notes.title: Major Patch - Claws & Chaos v1.06.18 is a Barrel of Monkeys!
notes.content:
In the latest patch for Claws & Chaos, we’ve made some significant changes to Rapture Mode.  Also, the Monkey family has entered the game! 

Heads up that this patch goes live in one hour, at 11am Eastern Time, and the game’s servers will be offline from now until then while we perform maintenance. 

Rapture mode now utilizes a Ranked System rather than the old leaderboard, new Rapture Cards with more meaningful choices, and new weekly Rewards!  

The Monkey family is now available in Arena and Rapture mode.  Sorry, Bird family, you’re out for now! Here’s each member of the Monkey family now available for battle: 
  Pre-Evolution Monkey
 Unethical Builder Gaboon
 Gorilla Brawler
 Monkey Agents
 Monkey Shaman
 Marmoset Ranger
 Monkey Guardian 
Here’s everything new and changed in Claws & Chaos v1.06.18

System Changes:
  Monkeys Added! The monkey family is now playable in Rapture and Arena!  Ranked System replacing the old Rapture leaderboard. In lieu of the design challenges of a King of the Hill system, we’ve created a skill-based ranking that will permanently exist on the leaderboard (no resets).   Earn Career Score by getting further in Rapture! Depending on your current rank, the points you earn will vary.  Find your place - Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master.  Players all start at 400 Rank points and climb up (or fall down) from there!  Rewards will be granted every week at the same time as Arena Leaderboard reset. Earn Acoins based on your Ranking! All players above Silver will earn a reward and decay -50 Rank points.   Masters = Rapture King Profile Frame + 200 Acoins  Diamond = 100 Acoins  Platinum = 75 Acoins  Gold = 50 Acoins  Silver = 25 Acoins   Arena Roster Rotation: Monkeys are in and Birds are out for Arena only! Rapture contains all units available, so you can still choose birds for the long haul.  New Rapture Cards will appear and present more meaningful choices. We’ve removed the crappy temporary cards no one wants - so each card presents some long term or economic benefit.  Main Menu music won’t start on splash screen, instead it will begin on main menu. 
Bug Fixes / QoL:
  Fix for Damage Tracker Display not filtering right when more than 8 units are tracked  Added sound cue for Poison abilities 
Campaign Balances:
  We have adjusted campaign battles to fix some bugs and improve the difficulty curve to better prepare players for PvP. 
 Fixed Chipmunk units (Chipmunk Soldier and Archer in Campaign, Chipmunk summoned by Chipmunk Monarch) to have the correct stats. 
Combat Balances:
Balance changes have the goal of bringing up the strength of melee units and addressing the over-reliance on Econ units
  Re-animated attacks for Multi-hit units such as Weeb Hamster and Preschooler Bunny to fix bugs where they would lose attacks at higher ATK SPD. This also results in cleaner, more fluid animations and much faster damage output.  Poison now deals 1 damage for each “stack” on a unit. Stacks persist forever unless specified.  Merging Food fix to prevent “free laxative” effect from occurring. Both units will combine their food count, while still maxing out at 4. 
Rabbits:
  Rabbit Middleschooler   ATK 8->7  
Raccoons
  Ringtail Miner   Ability now reads “On Deploy: Get 1 Free Refresh (Max one per turn)”   Red Panda Guardian   Ability scaling buffed from “On Refresh: Gain [5|6|7] Shield” to [7|10|13]  
Rodents
  Chipmunk Monarch   (Bug fix) Chipmunk summons now have 30 HP and 7 ATK at level 1 (up from 25 HP/6 ATK)   Plague Rat   Now inflicts 1/2/3 stacks of Poison per attack.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Claws & Chaos v1.01.17
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445888/37b67c118d945ed7dfba1753fb4cc0f7bfd8885f.jpg

We are one week out from the launch of Claws & Chaos, and the game’s first post-launch update has just gone live.  We’ve been reviewing player data, watching streams, and reading your reviews - we think you’ll be happy to read that most of this patch is about matchmaking and unit balancing. 

We’ve adjusted matchmaking to make matchups a bit more fair, added a combat timeout timer, added a Damage Dealt/Taken tracker to the combat screen, nerfed a few creatures, and buffed a few more. 

But that’s just the start. Read on for everything new, changed, and updated in Claws & Chaos v1.01.17.

And THANK YOU for playing our game, and giving us your feedback!

Systems   Matchmaking adjustment to make matchups feel more winnable. Note that with this patch, the matchmaking teams currently populated will also reset.  Rapture Leaderboard Reset will occur during this maintenance.  Login Retry button added to maintenance popup. Under unstable internet connections, we’ve noticed players fail the login despite Servers being up. Players can retry the login instead of exiting.  Combat timeout timer for when two units with a beta carotene overload are whacking each other and outhealing. After 1 minute of game time a burst of damage will kill everyone on field! 

UI/UX Adjustments   Added Damage Dealt/Taken tracker UI in combat.  Adjusted Campaign screen to always scroll to the right to show the latest chapter unlock.  ESC key should open up Settings menu in combat or main menu.  ESC key will close other popups in the main menu.  Fixed Rapture card history (deck in top left) to show proper activation phase.  Added Fine Threads to the main menu resource list.  Clarified tooltips for the main menu resource list to show where to acquire/spend.  Additional stat rows added in unit detail window (Phys Resist, Mag Resist, HP Regen).  Leaderboard rewards now display in the leaderboard window so you know what you’re placing for!

Bug Fixes   Twitch Integration !cc join command should now persist between waves.  Fixed bug in which in Profile’s Latest Campaign tracker wasn’t updating right.  Username creation’s word filter was being overzealous and preventing all caps names. This is now allowed again. Reasonable Username change requests can be made by opening a Discord ticket. 

Roster Balances
Introducing a stat cap: For all units stats now cap during battle (not just the shop phase) at 400 HP and 50 ATK. Any buffs applied during battle will not result in going over this cap. Critical hits can still go over 50 damage.

notes.title: Claws & Chaos is Now Live!
notes.content:
Hear ye, hear ye! Claws & Chaos has launched and the full game is now live on Steam!


Jump into our tactical autobattler now, start building squads of cute-but-deadly woodland creatures, and take down the tyrannical King Chipmunk!  


[previewyoutube=zhC8wqOy5Hk;full][/previewyoutube]
Please note that if you’ve played the demo or playtest previously, any and all progress has been wiped. You will start from scratch in the retail version of Claws & Chaos. 

If you haven’t played our game yet - welcome to the hand-drawn world of Claws & Chaos!  Here’s what to expect: 

  Expansive Campaign – Guide your woodland denizens through the impending apocalypse, exploring the world and story of Claws & Chaos through the single-player campaign.
 Vibrant, Hand-Drawn Aesthetic - The creatures at your command sure are cute…but they’re also deadly. Deploy Squirrell Archers, Plague Rats, Samurai Shibas, and more across bespoke battlefields.
 True Tactics - The aesthetics of Claws & Chaos may be adorable, but the need for strategy is real. Battles are deadly and can be over in just a few seconds - strategic thinking and sound tactical choices are key.
 Asynchronous PvP – Compete against other players’ best squads in the Arena, or tackle the endless Rapture Mode and climb the leaderboard to show the world whose creatures are the strongest. 
 Customization and Progression – Win battles to collect Tickets and Fine Threads, then use them to unlock new costumes, frames, and unique battlefields! 
Make sure to join us in our Discord server, too. Connect with the devs and community, and share your best clips and squads with us!

We have also collaborated with Backpack Battles - if you don't own it yet you can get both Backpack Battles and Claws & Chaos in a bundle and save money on both. Look out for some cool skins in both games too...

notes.title: Patch Notes - Claws & Chaos demo v0.45.15
notes.content:
The Claws & Chaos demo has been updated with a whole slew of updates, fixes, and balancing changes. 

Please note that the demo is separate from the Rapture Mode playtest running Sept 26 to Oct 3.  Rapture Mode will not be part of the demo, but we encourage you to join the playtest for the next week to try out this new mode. 

Here are the patch notes for v0.45.15 of the Claws & Chaos demo: 

System updates:
  New Matchmaking system incorporates more player metrics to better match up players and avoid lopsided engagements. Note that it is still possible to encounter teams that are luckier or feel difficult, but should happen much less. 
 Hero List now displays all units in-game. A toggle to filter current Arena Season is added in bottom left. 

UI / UX Adjustments
  Audio changes   New Music everywhere! Thanks to our musician Brian LaGuardia for composing a whole new soundtrack for Claws & Chaos.   New SFX for rewards    “Voice Acting” range increased to add a medium tone   New player default volume changed from 50% -> 30%    Leaderboard UI updated to use the book asset and add in Rapture tab  Rain particle added to Ark Battlefield 

Combat Changes

notes.title: Patch Notes - Claws & Chaos demo v0.35.13
notes.content:
Another bi-weekly patch to the Claws & Chaos demo is here, and this one makes some not-so-insignificant changes to combat and balancing. 

We’ve heard many of you loud and clear regarding the difficulty level of the Arena, especially at earlier levels. So, we’ve adjusted early game matchmaking to be more accommodating for new players. 

Also included are some changes to the in-combat economy. Population Up costs more, but this and the Shop Upgrade now reduce in cost every round they are not used. Selling creatures will also now net you more gold in return. 

Read on for all the changes in this version, and keep the feedback coming here on Steam and in our Discord! 

Systems
 Improved early game matchmaking for new players 
Combat Changes
 Population UP button now costs 4G 
 Population UP and Shop UP buttons will reduce in cost each turn.    Ex: If you don’t press the buttons, they will go down in cost by 1G next turn, rewarding a player’s patience.    Sell Mechanic Overhaul    All units now Sell for (Tier - 1) Gold. At Lv 2 and 3, unit value is multiplied by the Level. Previously, units always sold for gold equal to Level (1, 2, 3).   In-between levels do not count towards Sell. So hit the breakpoints and level up your heroes!  
Example: Lv. 2 Dog Paladin sells for 2G (1g x 2 lvls)   Lv. 1 Smoggy Bear sells for 3G   Lv 1.5 Smoggy Bear sells for 3G   Lv. 3 Smoggy Bear sells for 9G (3g x 3 lvls)    Consumables now have a 4 Stack Limit (unless flushed with Laxative)    To balance out the value of hyper rolling a single carry, we want people to diversify builds and explore different combinations. A unit can eat up to 4 Food before becoming “Full”.    Laxative Food added as a Tier 4 Food    At endgame, you may find yourself wanting to overfeed a unit. To do that, feed them a Laxative and continue consuming!  
UI/UX Adjustments
 Equip and Consumables UI completely overhauled to represent 4 Food cap and reduce clicks.   Sell units region now extends across the entire Shop bar, making it easier to see and drag units to.   Hover mouse over shop items to show tooltips without clicking   Improved error message when trying a Username that is already taken   Bearbarian OTK skin adjusted to be less “inspired” by parody source   Tooltips added to Shop/Population update buttons to show new “gold save” mechanic   Audio SFX added for Loot reward video featuring Tanuki bandit  SFX added for achievement reward claim popup   Minor button/text adjustments 
Bug Fixes
 On Deploy abilities will now properly trigger when combined into XP    Ex: Angora Grammy’s Gun spawns    Adjusted Megaphone radius bigger to better match visual radius.   Fixed Hat placements on some problem units   Adjusted angle of Hat placements (Waterstone, Lifestone, Crown)   Fixed Tanuki Bandit’s ability description   Fixed UI bug for Store UI on widescreens   Fixed XP Pips showing up when using a Latte to gain the last XP to lvl 3 
Roster Balances
AoE units are proving to be too strong in the meta, especially with the overpowered Marmoset! We’ve adjusted all AoE attack radius to be lower, matching the Cat Witch.   Impact Range of Marmoset Ranger, Rabbit Middleschooler, and Dog Librarian reduced from 1.5 -> 1.   Cat Witch Attack Speed increased slightly to be consistent with everyone else (0.6 -> 0.67)  
Birds
 Pirate Gully    Ability fixed so that Gully sells for the same total amounts after sell mechanic changes (3/6/9 Gold)    Lt. Colonel Marine    Shop End: Gain 2/4/6 ATK if you spent more than 12 gold this turn (up from 10 gold)  
Dogs
 Dog Paladin    HP 55 -> 40   Frat Bro    New Ability: Summons a new copy of Frat Bro, but retains HP modifications from Food.   HP 38 -> 30  
Hooved 
 Archbisheep    New Ability: Negate the first 3/4/5 hits of Magic Damage.    Alpaca Rapper    Attack Speed 0.8 -> 1    Highland Warrior    HP 33 -> 40   Attack Speed 0.8 -> 1  
Monkeys
 Marmoset Ranger    ATK 8 -> 6   ATK SPD 1 -> 0.67    Monkey Guardian    HP 90 -> 75  
Rabbits
 Angora Grammy    Cost of gun added to shop: 0 -> 1   HP 35 -> 26    Books Bunny    ATK 7 -> 8    Jackalope Runner    HP 23 -> 25   Increased knockback strength    Rabbit Middle Schooler    ATK 8 -> 7  
Raccoons
 Shady Food Vendor    ATK SPD 0.5 -> 1  
Rodents
 Chef Rat Louie    Now attacks twice   ATK 7 -> 4  
Equipment
 Carrot    Cost 3 -> 2    Shackle    Cost 3 -> 1   Effect duration 5 -> 2 sec

notes.title: Demo update v0.30.10 - A Barrel of Monkeys!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445888/f32c5710f62a4d6748b734fbb15561ff37caf734.png
We’ve just dropped an important new update to the Claws & Chaos demo, introducing the new Monkey Family, cosmetics to customize your creatures and battlefields, localization for a bunch of languages, adjustments to the economy, and a ton more. 

Before we get into the specifics, we have a cosmetic sneak peak to share…Starting today, check out the OTK Network crew of streamers to catch a glimpse of their very own in-game creature skins - Asmongold as a Raccoon, Sodapoppin as a SlimeCat, Emiru as a Rabbit, and more! These skins aren’t in the demo for everyone yet, you’ll have to wait a bit longer to get your hands on them. 

Here’s everything new in demo version 0.30.10:

System Updates
 Localization has been added for the following languages    Chinese, Traditional & Simplified   Japanese   Korean   German    Combat Cloud Save    Players can now exit and rejoin a session later! This is available in both Campaign and Arena mode.    Cosmetic Features and Economy adjustments    Gem system has been removed - introducing new Acoins and Tickets currencies.   Earn Acoins by doing Daily Missions - spend them on Thieve’s Haul to earn Creature Cosmetics. (Note: cosmetics earned in the demo will not carry over to the full game at launch.)  Earn Tickets from Lifetime achievements and Arena fights - spend them on Battlefield Skins.   Equip Hats and Costumes for your Creatures in the Unit Details screen.   Change your Battlefield backdrop via in-combat settings menu.  
UI / UX Adjustments
 Combat    Unit Descriptions adjusted to highlight Keywords.   In-combat Settings popup UI adjusted to add new functionality: Battlefield customization button + Save & Exit   Shop slots frame cleaned up to get rid of extra gray border behind Equipment and Consumables.   Fixed “Not enough gold” message popping up as you Lock shop slots with no gold.    Campaign Cutscene changes    Full illustrations are now animated!   Cutscenes will Fade out at the end for a smoother transition.    Settings Page UI size increased    Social media links added to Profile tab.   Font size increased.  
Combat Changes
 Healing (such as Aura and Passive Regeneration) ticks every second instead of every 2 seconds.   Heart Regain mechanic to ease the pain of early game losses:    When a player reaches 5 Wins, they can Heal back a lost Heart!   Added Equipment refund when replacing a hero’s equipment   To ease the pain of early game equipment investments, you can get 1G back from replacing items. So go ahead and replace that Scarf with a Gun.   Purchasing of identical Equipment on a Hero is now restricted, so you don’t waste Gold accidentally. 
Bug Fixes
 Audio BGM, SFX settings should now save properly between sessions.   Setting Audio sliders to 0 will now properly mute the game.   Fixed Fox Thief ability granting the wrong amount of Cloaking (7s instead of 5s)  
Roster Balance
Bears:
 Blearic    Healing changed from 2/4/6 per 2 sec -> 1/2/3 per 1 sec   No change in total healing over time due to healing tick change. 
Rodents
 Capybara    HP 70 -> 55   Ability heals for twice as much as it did before due to healing change. 
Rabbits
 Rabbit Trait Bonus    CRIT Chance per level 20% -> 15%. Now capped at 3 stacks, down from 4 stacks.   Books Bunny    ATK 5 -> 7   ATK Speed 0.67 -> 1   New Ability - On Crit: Stun target for 1/1.5/2 sec    Rabbit Necromancer    ATK 2 -> 8   New Ability - Battle Start: Summon a Lv 1/2/3 Skeleton. On Crit, summon another (3/4/5x per battle    Rabbit Plague Doctor    ATK 5 -> 6   ATK Speed 0.67 -> 1   Range 2 -> 3   New Ability - On Crit: Heal all allies for 4/6/8 HP   Added back into Arena Rotation   Angora Grammy    Damage Type Magical -> Physical   New Ability - Replace first shop item with a free Gun   (We were told Angora Grammy wasn’t packing enough heat. Attack animation adjusted to reflect her new concealed carry.)   Jackalope Runner    Tier 2 -> 1   HP 35 -> 23   Rabbit Blacksmith    Removed from Arena Rotation  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445888/ff26ea96895faa2d3d0235f5899c825d1a83b2b1.png

New Family: Monkeys
 Monkey Trait Bonus:    All Monkeys get +10HP for each stack of Trait Bonus.   3 Monkeys unlocks 1 stack   Max 2 stacks    Gorilla Brawler 3*:    Battle Start: Gain 2/3/4 ATK for every Ally with over 50 HP    Marmoset Ranger 4*:    First Attack: Stuns enemies. Deals area damage    Monkey Agents 3*:    Summon a Lv 1/2/3 Solo Agent. Counts as 2 Monkeys    Monkey Shaman 3*:    Gold Spent: Every 5 Gold, replace first shop item with a 2/1/0-cost Apple    Monkey Guardian 4*:    Passive: Immune to the first 3/4/5 attacks taken    Unethical Builder Gibbon 2*:    Shop Start: Gain 1/2/3 Gold. Poisons own team on battle start.    Pre-Evolution Monkey 2*:    Equipment Bought: Gain 3/5/7 HP  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445888/8931c49b1edae6ceea7ea549971e42bda2961136.png
No matter where you’re playing our demo, make sure to hop in our Discord to see what other players are up to and connect directly with us. And be sure to hit up OTK.to/CCPC to enter to win a custom Claws & Chaos PC!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Claws & Chaos Demo v5.0.19Demo
notes.content:
Our demo has been live on Steam Next Fest for only a couple of days, and thousands of you have hopped in. This is amazing and the feedback we've received, both here on Steam and in our Discord, has given us a lot to think about and work on. 

Based on that feedback, we've made some changes to the demo and just pushed an update live.  Read on for the patch notes!

System Updates
  Combine is no longer instant due to the amount of accidental combines players ran into. Instead, a bar will charge up for 0.8sec before Combine can happen.  Threshold for a click to be considered a “Drag” increased from 0.1s -> 0.15s  Should make clicking shop items for tooltips easier.  Reduced volume of intro cinematic  Tutorial teaching the “Family Bonuses” will now trigger in the tutorial stage much earlier. Default max frame rate will be set according to monitor specs (instead of uncapped). 
Unit Description Fixes 
 Gym Rat’s description is fixed. It said +1/2/3 ATK on attack, but was actually giving +3/6/9. Description is fixed, and ALSO balanced to +2/4/6 ATK on attack.  Preschooler Bunny’s multihit trait is displayed in description.  Fox Thief multihit trait displayed in description  Blearic ability fixed to show proper values (2/4/6 HP/2s).  Rabbit Plague Doctor ability scaling shows proper amounts (5/10/15 HP/s)  Kitten description added more details  Red Panda Guardian added more details
Unit Balance Updates
Slime (summon by Slime Cat)   HP 10 > 11  ATK 2 > 3    Bardy      Phys DMG Resist Aura 10/20/30% > 20/30/40%    Archibisheep      Magic DMG Resist Aura 10/20/30% > 20/30/40%    Bearbarian      ATK Speed 0.7 > 0.8    Rabbit Blacksmith      ATK 8 > 7    Dog Librarian      ATK 11 > 10    Rabbit Middleschooler      ATK 10 > 9    Gym Rat      See above for description bug fix. 1/2/3 > 2/4/6 ATK on attack.  
Family Balance Updates
Hoof Family   20 Shield / 5 ATK > 15 Shield / 4 ATK  
Don't forget to join our Discord, and follow us on socials. We're basically @clawsnchaos on everything. Oh and we're giving away a sweet gaming PC thanks to our friends at Mad Mushroom and Starforge Systems. Head to OTK.to/CC to enter :)
